ENTITLED:“A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING THE CITY OF CHEYENNE7
COMMUNITY RECREATION AND EVENTS DEPARTMENT TO
SUBMIT A PROPOSAL TO APPLY FOR AN OFFICE OF LOCAL
DEFENSE COMMUNITY COOPERATION, DEPARTMENT OF
DEFENSE, DEFENSE COMMUNITY INFRASTRUCTURE PROGRAM
GRANT TO BUILD AN INDOOR SPORTS COMPLEX TO SUPPORT THE
MILITARY FAMILY QUALITY OF LIFE INFRASTRUCTURE OF
FRANCISE.WARREN AIRFORCE BASE SERVICEMEMBERS AND
THEIR FAMILIES."
WHEREAS, the Defense Community Infrastructure Program Grant, offered through the
Office of Local Defense Community Cooperation, Department of Defense, is funded through the
Fiscal Year 2021 National Defense Authorization Act and approved on May 14, 2021 by the
Deputy Secretary of Defense; and
WHEREAS, the identified prior it iz ation of funding is the enhancement of military value,
enhancement of military installation resilience, and the enhancement of military family quality of
life; and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body recognizes a joint community need for an indoor sports
complex that serves Francis E. Warren Air Force Base, the Wyoming National Guard, and the
citizens of Cheyenne; and can offer gymnastics, basketball, volleyball, and indoor turf sports; and
WHEREAS, the total estimated cost of the project is approximately Fifteen Million Dollars
allow for partial funding to build (1) a gymnastics facility, (2) a gymnasium to house three
basketball courts, and (3) a fieldhouse with turf; and
WHEREAS, proposals must be construction ready within one year of the grant award and
must be expended withinfive(5) years from the date ofthegrant award (Fiscal Year 2021-Fiscal
Year2026); and
WHEREAS, a completed Memorandum of Understanding between the Cityof Cheyenne
and Francis E.Warren Air Force Base will be in effect for the duration of the project; and
WHEREAS, a match is not required; however, the city has allocated funds and donated
land west of the Cheyenne Ice and Events Center with an estimated value of One Million Two
Hundred Thousand Dollars ($1,200,000.00) toward the completion of this project; and
WHEREAS, if the proposal is accepted, the Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne
Wyoming grants approval for the City of Cheyenne Community Recreation and Events
NOW, THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY
OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING, that it is in support of this project and the City of Cheyenne
Community Recreation and Events Department is hereby authorized to submit a proposal and
subsequent application to apply for grant funding through the Office of Local Defense Community
Cooperation, Department of Defense for Fiscal Year 2021 - Fiscal Year 2026.
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the Mayor and City Clerk are authorized to execute
any and all documents, including a grant agreement, to secure funding under the DOD Defense
Community Infrastructure Program to the extent that such documents are consistent with this
Resolution.
